experiment: PyMS and the Verilog-A files beside a deck (the Xyce runner and the T3c owner, 2026-10-16, phase 2): E75's ires.va (r = `RDEF from ires_defs.include) copied beside the deck without its include, through a symbolic link to its real directory, and named in that directory; e2e 8's two modules named by relative .hdl paths, one directory each (vamos_va1/, vamos_va2/, run_xyce.place_va's layout) and both in one directory (mods/); E66's nan.va, which reads $abstime; the evaluator library's location under PYMS_VAE_CACHE; added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): a noisy Verilog-A resistor (white_noise) on the Y route in a 1k/1k divider, its .NOISE with and without DNO(X1), DNO(YNVR!X1)
result: a .va copied without the file it `includes relative to itself compiles with "preprocess: warning: 'ires_defs.include' not found (skipped)", rc 0, and a silently wrong result (I = -1e-12 A for -2.5e-4 A); a symbolic link does not carry the include either (it is looked up beside the link); two modules named by relative .hdl paths that hold a directory keep their parameters when each has its own directory, and (2026-10-17) lose them when both sit in one directory: "Unrecognized parameter R for device RX1", "Unrecognized parameter A for device YVRES!X2", rc 1, as E104's absolute paths; PyMS has no $abstime (a BuildError naming it; the module builds without it and runs, rc 0); the evaluator libraries go to PYMS_VAE_CACHE (default /tmp/pyms_vae_cache, shared by every run whatever PYMS_CACHE says; utils/PyMS/vae/xyce_device_gen.py:828-829). Added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): a PyMS device defines no DNO ("There was 1 undefined symbol in .PRINT command: device X1"; DNO(YNVR!X1) "is not defined"), rc 1, and its white_noise adds nothing to ONOISE (4.144e-18 V^2/Hz, R2's alone)
rules: §7.2 / §4.5 item 13: run_xyce.place_va copies every Verilog-A source with the files it `includes relative to itself, as files, and names each by its base name or under its own vamos_va<k>/ (never two modules in one directory)
§7.2: run_xyce narrates PyMS's BuildError lines (_DIAG_HEAD) as warnings
§11 Layout / D7: SpectreCase isolates PYMS_CACHE only; PYMS_VAE_CACHE stays shared
§8.4 / R-emit-8 (phase 2c): on Xyce a Verilog-A device's noise is neither printed (no DNO) nor counted in ONOISE
